name: The Closet Door
source:
Faun is a self-sure business diva. She's at the top of her prime and a success in her field. A force to be reckoned with, Faun couldn't ask for more. Her life looks complete. But looks aren't everything...

Everything is turned upside down for our diva when she falls into a place hidden away from the world she knows. She meets the three men who come to aide her upon her arrival- wait three magical men??? On top of it all, getting back home is going to prove more of a hassle than not. As Faun struggles to meet the challenges she must face to return home, she also finds she must depend on others equally- which may be the biggest challenge of all!

With all the fantastic things happening around Faun, something is nagging at her heart about the three mysterious men who now effect her fate. What could it be? And what will it mean when she faces what lies beyond...

The Closet Door

[from [url=https://tuffmallow.itch.io/the-closet-door-full]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Faun是一位自信的商业明星。她正处于巅峰期，并且在自己的领域取得了成功。Faun是一支不可忽视的力量，不能要求更多。她的人生看起来很完整。但外表并不代表一切…

当我们的女主角陷入一个远离她所熟悉的世界的地方时，一切都发生了翻天覆地的变化。她遇到了在她到达时前来帮助她的三个男人——等等三个神奇的男人？？？最重要的是，回家会比不回家更麻烦。当法恩努力应对回家所必须面对的挑战时，她也发现自己必须平等地依赖他人——这可能是最大的挑战！

法恩周围发生了所有奇妙的事情，而现在影响她命运的三个神秘男人却在她心中萦绕不去。可能是什么？当她面对超越的一切时，这意味着什么……

衣柜门
